requirementKinds.manual: needs a person to assess; never counted as passed
requirementKinds.untestable: cannot be tested (source material missing or paper ambiguous)

requirements.text: GroundMission extends DispatchMission, constructor chaining, isMedical()
energyUnits = 2*distanceKm + 5*loadKg with long intermediates and safe conversion to int
priority = 3 for a medical mission, otherwise 1
AirMission extends DispatchMission with windPenalty and critical properties, constructor and getters
air energy = 3*distance + 8*load + 2*wind; priority 5 if critical else 2
plan(capacity, urgentOnly): optional priority>=3 filter, sort priority DESC/energy ASC/ID ASC, greedy fit, skipped IDs in skip order, no concrete type checks
repository seeds AirMission(103,8,1,3,true)
requirements.note: instruction in the paper, no marks attached

requirements.text: energy(id) raises MissionNotFoundException for unknown ids
addAir validates positive id/distance, non-negative load/wind, unique id, values within 0-10,000
reject non-positive plan capacity; 400 for invalid input and 404 for missing mission with ApiError
GET /api/missions/{id}/energy returns a JSON object containing energyUnits
POST /api/missions/air accepts NewAirMission and returns 201 with the created mission
GET /api/missions/plan?capacity=..&urgentOnly=.. returns capacity, energyUsed, energyRemaining, selected, skipped; urgentOnly defaults to false
skipped list when urgentOnly filters missions out: are filtered-out IDs also reported as skipped?
requirements.note: The paper says 'record unselected IDs in skip order' but does not say whether filtered-out missions count. Tests do not assert it.

requirements.text: the 0-10,000 range applies to the id field as well as distance/load/wind?
requirements.note: Paper says 'values within 0-10,000' without naming id. Tests only assert distance, load and wind.

requirements.text: GroundMission(101) consumes 39 energy units and has priority 3
AirMission(103) consumes 38 units and has priority 5
capacity 60: greedy dispatch selects [103,102] and skips [101]
urgentOnly=true excludes the routine mission
bad capacity and invalid POST return 400; unknown ID returns 404
successful POST returns 201 and later planning incorporates the new mission
